crossRefs.note: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.
For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.
For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy, says: “I dwell in the high and holy place, with…
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
‘Behold, I will bring it health and cure, and I will cure them; and I will reveal to them abundance of peace and truth.
“Come! Let’s return to Yahweh; for he has torn us to pieces, and he will heal us; he has injured us, and he will bind…
After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap…
“The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal…
Why should you be beaten more, that you revolt more and more? The whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it: wounds, welts, and open sores. They haven’t…

translations.web: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
translations.bsb: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
translations.kjv: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.
translations.asv: He healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.
